title: Cut the development GitHub environment over to the new account
description: Change the development GitHub environment's AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN secret to the new account's role so pushes to develop deploy there, after the development environment is verified. Reversible by setting the secret back. Then repoint dev.chattic.us, leave legacy development running until confident, then retire it. Needs explicit approval from Ryan at the moment of the switch.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Development cutover done: PR 380 merged, development environment AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN now targets the dedicated development account, and the three development deploy workflows ran green and updated ChatticusThinTurn, ChatticusWeb and ChatticusAuth there. comments.text: Done and superseded 2026-10-19: the development GitHub environment was first cut over to the dedicated development account (PR 380) and has now been repointed to the production AWS account (PR 610 merged, delegation PR 611).
